relIndexlatStabilizer.name: Data.relIndex_latStabilizer
relIndexlatStabilizer.statement:
lemma relIndex_latStabilizer : (comap D.filling.inclHFin D.filling.latStabilizer).relIndex (Kf ..) =
  (D.N ^ D.k - 1 : ℝ) ^ D.f

cardclassesfilling.name: Data.card_classes_filling
cardclassesfilling.statement:
lemma card_classes_filling : card D.filling.Classes =
  Nat.card (D.filling.reducedImage besselH) * (D.N ^ D.k - 1) ^ D.f * mass D.E D.k

stdClassSumcarrierXieqlineMultiplier.name: Data.stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_lineMultiplier
stdClassSumcarrierXieqlineMultiplier.statement:
lemma Data.stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_lineMultiplier {P} {D : Data P} j i {n} (f g : _ → n) :
  renameRowsCols id (f ∘ D.basisVec ∘ (↑) ⊕ᵥ g) (stackedDetProd (posEquiv j) (detRows j i)) = ∑ l,
  renameRowsCols id f (letterPoly (D.signsW j) (untwistedAuxPair j).ord 1 _ (Pi.single l 1)) *
  renameRowsCols id g ((linePolyCoords j i) l)

existsbesselSystem.name: Data.exists_besselSystem
existsbesselSystem.statement:
lemma Data.exists_besselSystem v : ∃ B : BesselSystem _ D.b D.f,
  IsBessel B (D.paramW v) (D.κ v)

filling.name: Data.filling
filling.statement:
noncomputable def Data.filling := by refine' (Filling.mk (fintypeChosen := _) _ _ D.piIdele _ _ _ _
  D.classAut_columnLevel_eq_bot (D.exists_besselSystem · |>.choose) (mod_cast D.piIdele_spec.1.symm)
  D.N_prime (by grind [D.piIdele_spec.2, D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.q_eq]) (coe_mem_Ô _) (⟨D.g_prime ·,
  D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound.ne⟩) (D.g_mem · |>.1) (D.g_mem · |>.2)
  (@q_eq_g _ D · · ·.2) D.isConjApart_chosen.1 (IsChosen.not_star ·.1 ·.1) (fun r ↦ by
       refine .trans ?_ (.trans (forall_congr' fun i ↦ (dvd_iff_reduceAt_eq_zero
         (Parameters.intValuation_p · (Parameters.not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_modEq_one (D.g_modEq_one i)))
         r).trans ?_) Sigma.forall.symm) <;> simp
       use (by grw [← ·]; simp),
         And.elim (Nat.Coprime.cast (by grind [Nat.coprime_primes, Data])).mul_dvd
       use fun h a ⟨_, k⟩ ↦ ⟨h a k, h _ (by simpa)⟩, fun h w k ↦ by_cases (h w ⟨·, k⟩ |>.1) fun n ↦
         star_star w ▸ (h _ ⟨(D.isChosen_star_iff k).2 n, by simpa⟩).2) D.card_chosenPlace P.star_ϖ
  P.different_eq_span_varpi ..) <;> and_intros <;> (try rify [Shape.k, card_X₀,
  finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace, inv_pow, pow_mul']) <;> use D.le_of_hasLogBound

IsIntegralOff.name: Filling.IsIntegralOff
IsIntegralOff.statement: abbrev IsIntegralOff (x : S.GFin) := x.1 ∈ intGL _ (integralOff T)

cosetAmplitude.name: Filling.cosetAmplitude
cosetAmplitude.statement:
noncomputable def cosetAmplitude [Side] c s c' γ := ∑' x : besselU .. × besselU ..,
  ite (S.IsIntegralOff T (S.termPosition c c x.1.1) ∧
  x.1.1 * γ * x.2.1⁻¹ ∈ S.termsOver c s c') (S.amplitude c c' (x.1.1 * γ * x.2.1⁻¹)) 0

toPlaces.name: Filling.toPlaces
toPlaces.statement:
noncomputable def toPlaces :=
  U.map (evalPlaces T) (star_evalPlaces T · |>.symm) (S.map_splitGram_latMiddle _)

IsFillingLevel.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel
IsFillingLevel.statement:
class IsFillingLevel [P : IntegralPlace (LocProd T)] (F : Level (Fin (𝔰.k - (6 * 𝔰.ϱ + 13)))
  (S.latMiddle (LocProd T)) (𝔰.ϱ + 1 + 2 * 𝔰.ϱ + 5)) : Prop extends P.IsStdLevel F where
  psi_eq : P.ψ = S.charOnPlaces T
  g_eq : F.g = S.gIdele.map (evalPlaces T)

eventuallymemintegralOff.name: Filling.eventually_mem_integralOff
eventuallymemintegralOff.statement: lemma eventually_mem_integralOff (a : 𝔸f E) : ∀ᶠ T in .atTop, a ∈ integralOff T

eventuallyisIntegralOff.name: Filling.eventually_isIntegralOff
eventuallyisIntegralOff.statement:
lemma eventually_isIntegralOff : ∀ᶠ T in .atTop,
  S.IsIntegralOff T x

existsplacesintegralOff.name: Filling.exists_places_integralOff
existsplacesintegralOff.statement:
lemma exists_places_integralOff (T₀ : Finset Eˣ) : ∃ᶠ T in .atTop, T.StarStable ∧
  (∀ t ∈ T₀, ↑t ∈ ratIntegralOff T ∧ ↑t⁻¹ ∈ ratIntegralOff T) ∧ Fact (↑S.gIdele⁻¹ ∈ integralOff T) ∧
  S.latBasis ∈ intGL _ (integralOff T) ∧ (S.N : E)⁻¹ ∈ ratIntegralOff T

ratToInfweylElemmul.name: Filling.ratToInf_weylElem_mul
ratToInfweylElemmul.statement:
lemma ratToInf_weylElem_mul {σ p} v : S.ratToInf (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * σ) v = weylElem 𝔰.ϱ (fun i ↦
  unitOrOne (S.frameScaleSq v i * Φ v (p i))) * S.ratToInf σ v

existstoPlaceseq.name: Filling.exists_toPlaces_eq
existstoPlaceseq.statement:
lemma exists_toPlaces_eq y : ∃ x, S.toPlaces T x = y ∧ S.IsIntegralOff T x ∧
  (y ∈ besselU → x ∈ besselU) ∧ (y ∈ besselH →
  x ∈ besselH)

memunitaryLeveliff.name: Filling.mem_unitaryLevel_iff
memunitaryLeveliff.statement:
lemma mem_unitaryLevel_iff {u} (h : ↑u⁻¹ ∈ integralOff T) : x ∈ unitaryLevel (Ô E) u _ ↔
  S.IsIntegralOff T x ∧ S.toPlaces T x ∈ unitaryLevel O (u.map (evalPlaces T)) _

memlatStabilizeriff.name: Filling.mem_latStabilizer_iff
memlatStabilizeriff.statement:
lemma mem_latStabilizer_iff : x ∈ S.latStabilizer ↔ S.IsIntegralOff T x ∧ S.toPlaces T x ∈
  unitaryLevel O 1 _

existsisFillingLevel.name: Filling.exists_isFillingLevel
existsisFillingLevel.statement:
lemma exists_isFillingLevel [WeilData E]
    (T : Finset _) [T.StarStable] : ∃ _ : IntegralPlace (LocProd T), ∃ F,
  S.IsFillingLevel T F

termPositionfloorGroupspec.name: Filling.termPosition_floorGroup_spec
termPositionfloorGroupspec.statement:
lemma termPosition_floorGroup_spec {σ} (u :
  σ ∈ GT 𝔰.ϱ) c c' : let L := S.termPosition c c' σ; let φ := algebraMap E (𝔸f E)
    let ω j := σ.1.1 (𝔰.indexX₀ j) 𝔰.z
    let t := S.frameProducts σ 𝔰.top 𝔰.top; L ∈ GT 𝔰.ϱ ∧ orbitPoint 𝔰.top L⁻¹ = tailVector S.piBar
      (φ t) (c.out⁻¹.1.1 *ᵥ φ ∘ ω) ∧ S.N * star ω ⬝ᵥ ω = t * star t - S.N ^ 2 ∧ ∀ p,
      S.termPosition c c' (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * σ) = weylElem 𝔰.ϱ (Units.map φ ∘ p) * L

existshasSumcosetAmplitude.name: Filling.exists_hasSum_cosetAmplitude
existshasSumcosetAmplitude.statement:
lemma exists_hasSum_cosetAmplitude [WeilData E] [S.IsAdmissible] {π : Side} {c s c' Λ} (h :
  S.amplitudeSum (S.termsOfLink Λ) c s c' ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ γ ∈ S.termsOver c s c', ∀ l, leadingMinor
  (S.frameProducts γ) l ≠ 0) : ∃ (t : Eˣ) (σ : S.G E), ∃ k, (σ ∈ GT 𝔰.ϱ ∧ S.frameProducts σ 𝔰.top
  𝔰.top = t ∧ (∀ v, S.N ^ 2 < ‖Φ v t.1‖ ^ 2) ∧ S.reduction k = s ∧ Λ = link (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ 1 * σ)) ∧
  ∃ L, HasSum L (S.amplitudeSum (S.termsOfLink Λ) c s c') ∧ ∀ p : Fin 𝔰.ϱ → _, Filter.Tendsto
  (fun T ↦ S.cosetAmplitude T c s c' (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ (padTuple p t) * σ)) .atTop (nhds (L p))

binders.name: hs
binders.type: ∀ γ ∈ S.termsOver c s c', ∀ l, leadingMinor (S.frameProducts γ) l ≠ 0

tailVectorevalPlaces.name: Filling.tailVector_evalPlaces
tailVectorevalPlaces.statement:
lemma tailVector_evalPlaces t (x : 𝔰.κ → _) : tailVector (S.piBar.map (evalPlaces T)) (evalPlaces T
  t) (evalPlaces T ∘ x) = evalPlaces T ∘ tailVector S.piBar t x

mdevalPlacesrpowhalf.name: IntegralPlace.md_evalPlaces_rpow_half
mdevalPlacesrpowhalf.statement:
lemma _root_.IntegralPlace.md_evalPlaces_rpow_half {x : Eˣ} (h : ↑x ∈ ratIntegralOff T ∧
  ↑x⁻¹ ∈ ratIntegralOff T) : P.md (evalPlaces T x) ^ (2⁻¹ : ℝ) = (∏ v, ‖Φ v x.1‖ₑ)⁻¹

memprincipalLeveliff.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel.mem_principalLevel_iff
memprincipalLeveliff.statement:
lemma IsFillingLevel.mem_principalLevel_iff : x ∈ S.principalLevel ↔ S.IsIntegralOff T x ∧
  S.toPlaces T x ∈ F.congGroup

reductioneqiff.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel.reduction_eq_iff
reductioneqiff.statement:
lemma IsFillingLevel.reduction_eq_iff : S.reduction k = S.reduction l ↔
  (S.toPlaces T k)⁻¹ * S.toPlaces T l ∈ F.congGroup

psisimpleRootSumequnipotentChar.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel.psi_simpleRootSum_eq_unipotentChar
psisimpleRootSumequnipotentChar.statement:
lemma IsFillingLevel.psi_simpleRootSum_eq_unipotentChar (h : S.IsIntegralOff T x) :
  P.ψ (F.g⁻¹ * simpleRootSum (S.toPlaces T x)) = S.unipotentChar x

mdg.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel.md_g
mdg.statement: lemma IsFillingLevel.md_g : P.md F.g = (S.g ^ numInfPlaces E : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ 2

cardreducedImagemul.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel.card_reducedImage_mul
cardreducedImagemul.statement:
lemma IsFillingLevel.card_reducedImage_mul {B μ} [SFinite μ] (a : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, ∃ x ∈ B, S.toPlaces T x =
  z ∧ S.IsIntegralOff T x) (r : ∀ x ∈ B, μ ∗ₘ .dirac (S.toPlaces T x) = μ) : Nat.card
  (S.reducedImage B) * μ F.congGroup = μ (unitaryLevel P.R 1 (S.latMiddle _).splitGram)

binders.name: a
binders.type: ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, ∃ x ∈ B, S.toPlaces T x = z ∧ S.IsIntegralOff T x

binders.name: r
binders.type: ∀ x ∈ B, μ ∗ₘ .dirac (S.toPlaces T x) = μ

correlationsmuleqcosetAmplitude.name: Filling.IsFillingLevel.correlation_smul_eq_cosetAmplitude
correlationsmuleqcosetAmplitude.statement:
lemma IsFillingLevel.correlation_smul_eq_cosetAmplitude [S.IsAdmissible] [Side] {σ p c c'} {Z :
  F.IntermediateGroup} {k : S.latStabilizer} (u : σ ∈ GT 𝔰.ϱ) (o : S.IsIntegralOff T
  (S.termPosition c c' (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * σ))) {a b : Z.Cosets} (e : (S.toPlaces T k)⁻¹ * a.out.1 *
  b.out.1⁻¹ ∈ F.congGroup) : let q := Units.map (ratToPlaces T) ∘ p; let γ := weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * σ
    F.correlation Z q (S.toPlaces T (S.termPosition c c' σ))⁻¹ (a, b) • besselCorrelation volume
      (.toLp 2 <| S.besselFn ·) (S.ratToInf γ) = (F.headDensity 𝔰.ϱ q 1).toReal •
      F.groupMeasure.real F.congGroup • S.cosetAmplitude T c (S.reduction k) c' γ

binders.name: o
binders.type: S.IsIntegralOff T (S.termPosition c c' (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * σ))
